**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 08:17
- [FACT] User has a mid-century modern coffee table that needs refinishing.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for reliable services for furniture restoration.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources for finding a good furniture restorer include:
  - The Furniture Society
  - The Guild of American Luthiers
  - The American Institute for Conservation of Historic and Artistic Works (AIC)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested online directories and reviews for furniture restorers:
  - Google Reviews
  - Yelp
  - Thumbtack
  - Angie's List
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Local resources for finding furniture restorers include:
  - Antique Dealers and Collectors
  - Furniture Stores and Design Centers
  - Local Woodworking or Craft Schools
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Questions to ask a potential restorer include:
  - Experience with mid-century modern pieces
  - Portfolio of previous restoration projects
  - Materials and techniques used
  - Restoration process
  - Timeline and cost
  - Insurance and liability
  - References from previous clients
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for finding a furniture restorer include:
  - Get multiple quotes
  - Check credentials
  - Inspect their workshop
  - Ask about conservation ethics
- [FACT] User is also looking for local antique appraisers to evaluate their great-grandmother's locket.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources for finding a reputable antique appraiser include:
  - Appraisers Association of America (AAA)
  - International Society of Appraisers (ISA)
  - National Association of Jewelry Appraisers (NAJA)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested online directories and reviews for antique appraisers:
  - Google Reviews
  - Yelp
  - Thumbtack
  - Angie's List
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Local resources for finding antique appraisers include:
  - Antique Dealers and Collectors
  - Auction Houses
  - Museums and Historical Societies
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Questions to ask a potential appraiser include:
  - Experience with antique jewelry
  - Qualifications and certifications
  - Appraisal methodology
  - Fees
  - Insurance and liability
  - Report and documentation
  - USPAP compliance
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for finding an antique appraiser include:
  - Get multiple appraisals
  - Check credentials
  - Ask about conflicts of interest
  - Check for any disciplinary actions
